title: OpenWAM & 动作表示
description: 双臂积木分类实验：18 维关节动作的学习与执行、颜色误分类，以及末端表示与预训练权重的关系。
descriptionEn: Bimanual block sorting: learning and executing 18-coordinate joint actions, color errors, and the relationship between TCP representations and pretrained weights.

title: OpenWAM
description: 视频生成先验如何支持机器人动作学习：模块化架构、世界与动作的信息流，以及跨域预训练的实验结果。
descriptionEn: How video-generation priors support robot action learning: modular architectures, world–action information flow and cross-domain pretraining results.

title: DiT Heads
description: 比较扩散 Transformer 策略与动作头，推导条件注入和 MTD 张量流，结合玩偶实验分析执行窗口、松爪与底盘速度。
descriptionEn: Diffusion Transformer policies and action heads, conditioning and MTD tensor flow, with toy-task experiments on execution windows, release and base velocity.

title: SmolVLA & 数值类型
description: 从视觉语言特征、流匹配与异步动作块，到 BF16 更新舍入，结合玩偶抓取的训练、曲线和实机表现分析实验。
descriptionEn: Visual-language features, flow matching, asynchronous chunks and BF16 update rounding, connected to toy-collection training, trajectories and robot experiments.

title: 轻量化结构设计
description: 讨论材料与结构的轻量化方法，结合机器人设计，推导承载效率、吸能、能量法与尺寸优化，并分析夹层结构的刚度和失效。
descriptionEn: Material and structural lightweight design, robot integration, load efficiency, energy absorption, energy methods, sizing optimization, and sandwich stiffness and failure.

title: pi0.7
description: 从条件化数据到视觉子目标，梳理 π0.7 的架构、流匹配、记忆与训练方法，以及泛化实验和经验学习。
descriptionEn: A close reading of π0.7: context conditioning, visual subgoals, flow matching, memory, training, and learning from experience.

title: ACT with CrossEntropyLoss
description: 从底盘离散速度出发，理解交叉熵、L1 与 KL，以及视觉输入、潜变量和时序融合对 ACT 控制行为的影响。
descriptionEn: From discrete base velocities to cross-entropy, L1, KL, visual features, latent variables, and temporal ensembling in ACT.
